escena.titulo: Natural capital and the fish lake

turnos.t: Stock: 10,000 fish. In: 1,000 immigrate and 4,500 young survive, plus 5,500. Out: 2,000 emigrate and 3,000 die, minus 5,000. Net change: plus 500 fish a year. That 500 is the natural income.

A harvests 2,500 a year: net minus 2,000, so the stock is gone by year 5. B harvests 500: net zero, it stays at 10,000, a steady state. C harvests nothing and reaches 15,000 in year 10. The rule: a sustainable harvest is less than or equal to the natural income.
